_comment: Independent public-input witness for botl.c status_eval_next_unhilite() (botl.c:2279-2319) and the gu.update_all timer reset in eval_notify_windowport_field() (botl.c:1574-1576). A Valkyrie with an experience-level/up highlight gains levels, lets a turn pass so the highlight timer starts, and polymorphs; set_uasmon() requests update_all, but evaluate_and_notify_windowport() skips BL_XP while Upolyd, so its timer survives and later sets disp.botl on every turn with multi == 0. After a travel leaves context.run at 8, only that botl repaints the turn counter at the end of a counted search.
